profile.name: NanoScanZ 纳米调焦压电Z轴平台
profile.description: 这是一种用于显微镜或精密定位系统的压电驱动Z轴纳米调焦平台，可在垂直方向进行高分辨率升降与精密对焦，适用于显微成像、焦点扫描和样品的精细Z向定位。
profile.description_en: A piezo-driven Z-axis nano focusing stage for microscopes or precision positioning systems. It provides high-resolution vertical motion and fine focus control for microscopy, focus scanning, and precise sample positioning along the Z axis.
